senses.gloss: SV0069 ब्रम्हचर्य bramhacarya Avoidance of sexual act physically, mentally & verbally all ways under any circumstances. Control over genital organ, which leads to pleasant mind & helpful to attain knowledge about Bramha (supreme god)

SV0068 ब्रम्हा मुहूर्त bramhā muhūrta Brahmā means relating to Bramha or creator or supreme spirit or to sacred knowledge or study or divine or presided over by a Bramha. Muhūrta refers to partic, period of the day. Brahmā muhūrta includes time between 4th Ghatika and 2nd Ghatika before sunrise, or 48 minutes of auspicious period before sunrise. It’s the relevant time for thinking brahmā or to study.
BP0077 ब्रह्मचर्य brahmacarya A state of continence and chastity abstaining from sexual relations and experience
